threshold_selection: epoch checkpoints jointly score native, 0 dB, +10 dB, and short-noise development cohorts; the operating threshold must be frozen later with the opened 2024 continuous stream

v25_population_first_selection.order: construct complete provider split and K-NET joint event/station partition; apply target-population metadata filters; apply deterministic record limits last
v25_population_first_selection.knet_development_partition: provider event dev AND independently hashed station dev

instancegm_training_quality_filter.policy: retain every labeled acceleration event in the target population; official component SNR is used for weighting and stratified reporting, never record deletion

cwa2020_opened_event_context_training.split: event-disjoint prospective split stored in the packet-store metadata; development rows are not added to generic training or controlled-SNR loaders
cwa2020_opened_event_context_training.preprocessing: frozen 200-to-100 Hz causal FIR, PacketQualityGateV5, packet EWMA normalization, and candidate-enabled mask
cwa2020_opened_event_context_training.supervision: native long pre-P context with P+0 through P+3 verifier labels; no synthetic relocation or waveform mixing
cwa2020_opened_event_context_training.quality_reset_boundary: Rows containing a quality-invalid packet inside the stored context are explicitly excluded because the generic batched trainer cannot reset model state within one sequence.
cwa2020_opened_event_context_training.evidence_boundary: CWA 2020 is already-opened development data and cannot become independent confirmation evidence

event_target_scope.deployment_boundary: Magnitude and source-station distance define the target population; they are unavailable at first-P station inference and are not model inputs.

continuous_noise.selection: prediction-independent QC-valid non-overlapping windows, then catalog-screened to presumed non-event status before negative supervision
continuous_noise.claim_boundary: Catalog-screened presumed non-event windows; absence from the assembled catalogs does not certify physical noise

reviewed_hard_negative_training.scope: training only; local packet masks around provisionally reviewed triggers; all rows also pass the catalog screen; not used as generic event noise beds; development and blind sets unchanged
reviewed_hard_negative_training.sampler_effect: a separate continuous-noise source group receives an equal share of the configured continuous noise-class mass

target_fdsn_actual_trigger_windows.supervision: local masks around catalog-screened presumed non-event actual triggers; causal packet context receives no negative loss
target_fdsn_actual_trigger_windows.normalization_contract: window-start causal EWMA state is restored when present; stores without state retain the legacy reset-at-window behavior
target_fdsn_actual_trigger_windows.claim_boundary: presumed non-event operational triggers, not certified physical noise

target_fdsn_background_event_mixing.claim_boundary: QC/catalog-screened presumed non-event target-domain backgrounds; used for event mixing, not independent evidence

knet_causal_raw_input.preprocessing: none; raw acceleration values are stored exactly as decoded from BSON. DC removal and scale estimation occur causally per packet at runtime
forbidden_operations: whole-record detrending that uses post-arrival samples
knet_causal_raw_input.split_provenance: event-disjoint split copied from the existing metadata; station-factorized subsets are applied later by the frozen training protocol

data_pipeline: contiguous true-native event crops plus independent-noise assembly, seam-matched relocation for the synthetic branch, and 1 s local P-window excess-power SNR with nominal, constructed-achieved, and empirical values stored separately
label: causal 2-packet candidate window and confirmation packets P+0 through P+3; no pre-P positives; arrival-age models regress causal elapsed time at each confirmation packet

native_event_policy.definition: contiguous crop from the original waveform with its original background; no relocation, background replacement, added noise, component augmentation, or injected artifact
native_event_policy.eligibility: requires enough original pre-P warmup and post-P guard inside the selected sequence; ineligible draws use the synthetic branch
native_event_policy.replacement_sampler_nonce: repeated draws of one training record receive deterministic distinct augmentation seeds; development draws remain fixed

checkpoint_selection: highest geometric mean of native usable rate, native noise specificity, 0 dB usable rate, and +10 dB usable rate among thresholds meeting the minimum native-noise specificity constraint
hard_negative_loss: separately weighted top probabilities on pure-noise records and on event records before P or after the three-packet response window
final_blind_test: CWA _2021; prohibited during model and threshold development

packet_once_contract.training_boundary_phase: event P is relocated to a uniformly sampled integer sample, so all 50 packet phases are eligible independently in every epoch
packet_once_contract.streaming_equivalence_test: full causal convolution, arbitrary blocked replay, and one-packet replay must agree within 1e-5
packet_once_contract.spectral_features: fixed DFT band fractions, vertical fractions, entropy, and centroid from the fully received current packet only
packet_once_contract.training_initialization: frozen V27 candidate with a newly initialized verifier
packet_once_contract.complete_packet_morphology: the current 0.5-second packet is encoded once; dense phase interpolation never crosses a packet boundary
packet_once_contract.cross_packet_context: unidirectional two-layer GRU plus previous-packet embedding; no future packet or raw replay
packet_once_contract.within_packet_dense_p_evidence: 50-sample P logits are supervised at the annotated sample and their peak and soft mass enter the candidate head
packet_once_contract.event_head_role: detached nonlinear episode verifier with the none direct packet feature ablation
packet_once_contract.integrated_outputs: candidate probability, auxiliary event evidence, causal P-arrival age, and within-packet P logits
packet_once_contract.architecture_change_scope: preserve the frozen V27 candidate, timing, and dense phase branches; vary only direct verifier packet evidence
packet_once_contract.verifier_supervision_rule: detached candidate support OR positive verifier label; retain all locally masked reviewed hard-negative packets

development_evaluation.checkpoint_selection: disabled; final epoch fixed before training
